issue_request: FHIR-49226 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core Questionnaire. It asked that Questionnaire.item.maxLength support date use cases already possible in ElementDefinition; the resolution was to add date, dateTime, and time and remove boolean.
initial_application: Commit 370a13b5c3cd9b8be8de15b4abcc4404c5861618 changed ElementDefinition.maxLength wording toward primitive values that have length, and commit 24e5953c3f324c274613d15334ecacf76c52d27b changed Questionnaire que-10 to replace boolean with date/dateTime/time. No prior Issue-Reconcile-Key for FHIR-49226 was found on the combined branch before this audit.
additional_context: The 2025-02-27 SDC minutes record FHIR-49226 as Persuasive. Zulip Questionnaire threads show the practical date-precision use case and the desire for Questionnaire and ElementDefinition consistency. FHIR-22128 later cleaned up the ElementDefinition wording while preserving primitive date-capable maxLength scope.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current Questionnaire que-10 expression includes date, dateTime, and time and excludes boolean; ElementDefinition.maxLength also permits primitive data where character length has meaning.
